A grand '''ceremony''' was undertaken by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] on the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|captured]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]]. With many high ranking Yuuzhan Vong in attendance, the ceremony was to be the one of the greatest ones to have ever been done by the [[Species/Legends|species]]. However, [[Shamed Ones]] interrupted the ceremony and liberated the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] captives that were to be sacrificed.
